description: Check P3-4 of the galerkin step (tests/galerkin/test_conventions.py): the closed list of the conjugations in the package code of galerkin, refsol and simcase outside the _conventions modules and simcase's P2-15 boundary functions. Each is mathematics (a Hermitian product, a phase fix, an adjoint, a complex-step derivative), never a change of time convention. Written in L3 commit 10 from map M2 2.3 (29 galerkin and 17 simcase code lines) and refsol.fiber, plus the two complex-step lines the map missed. An entry is matched by package, file, function and normalized source line, with the count of sites on that line; entries only ever leave the list.
